# givemotion

> Make videos with AI, free and open source (MIT). A free code-to-video engine built for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex): the agent writes one HTML/CSS/JS page, checks it (`check`), looks at key frames (`snapshot`) and renders MP4/WebM/ProRes/GIF. After an edit, a new render redoes only the 1-2 s parts that changed, byte-identical to a full render. Free for any use, including companies (MIT, zero npm dependencies, no telemetry, no account). Needs Node 20+, ffmpeg and Chrome.

Created by Leonardo Grigorio (https://github.com/leonardogrig) as an independent open-source project. Website: https://givemotion.org. Compared with HyperFrames and Remotion in the README ("How it compares").

Install in a project: `npx givemotion init my-video` (starter video + the agent skill pack) or `npx givemotion skill` (skill pack only: `.claude/skills/givemotion/`, `.agents/skills/givemotion/`, and a section in `AGENTS.md`). As a Claude Code plugin: `/plugin marketplace add givemotion/givemotion`, then `/plugin install givemotion@givemotion`. With the skills CLI: `npx skills add givemotion/givemotion`. Then ask the agent for a video.

Core loop: plan a shot list → write HTML → `npx givemotion check file.html` → `npx givemotion snapshot file.html` (look at snapshots/sheet.png) → `npx givemotion render file.html -o out/video.mp4`.

## Agent skill (read SKILL.md first, the rest on demand)

- [SKILL.md](skills/givemotion/SKILL.md): the loop, composition format, timing model, quality rules, built-in motion, presets, blocks, and which reference to read when.
- [techniques/](skills/givemotion/references/techniques/): one short recipe per technique (logo reveal, kinetic type, text reveals, camera, transitions, light, charts, paths/maps, shapes, UI demo, code, impacts, captions, hand-drawn, backgrounds).
- [api.md](skills/givemotion/references/api.md): built-in attributes, presets, easings, preset CSS, blocks.
- [motion-design.md](skills/givemotion/references/motion-design.md): motion design principles with numbers (timing, easing, camera grammar, continuity) and what blind judges punished.
- [styles.md](skills/givemotion/references/styles.md): eight named looks (palette tokens, fonts, background, motion personality).
- [timeline.md](skills/givemotion/references/timeline.md): full `gm.timeline` / `gm.fly` API, sequences, cuts, cut-align, the morph transition.
- [camera.md](skills/givemotion/references/camera.md): `gm.camera` over a world, shot options, parallax, path travel, one object riding another.
- [charts.md](skills/givemotion/references/charts.md): live line charts (`gm.chart.line`), chart blocks, counters.
- [diagrams.md](skills/givemotion/references/diagrams.md): arrows (`gm.connect`), hand-drawn (`data-sketch`), `data-anchor` labels, shapes and path morphs.
- [media-audio.md](skills/givemotion/references/media-audio.md): video, audio, beats, `data-pulse`, `gm.audio`, captions, fonts.
- [data-templates.md](skills/givemotion/references/data-templates.md): `--data`, `{{data.…}}`, `<gm-include>`, blocks, the cursor block.
- [javascript.md](skills/givemotion/references/javascript.md): `gm.onFrame` and helpers, particle bursts, seekable JS rules, canvas, Lottie.
- [output.md](skills/givemotion/references/output.md): render options, the parts cache, render speed, transparent overlays, bundle and `<gm-player>`, React.
- [review.md](skills/givemotion/references/review.md): snapshot/inspect/check recipes, reading a sheet, `analyze` for reference videos.
- [check-codes.md](skills/givemotion/references/check-codes.md): every `check` code and how to fix it, `data-check`.
- [genres/](skills/givemotion/references/genres/): explainer, data story, promo, UI demo, code explainer, logo sting, vertical short, whiteboard, year recap.

## More

- [README](README.md): overview, commands, performance, how it works.
- [Blocks](blocks/): copyable HTML building blocks; each file's header lists params and usage.
- [Examples](examples/): complete compositions.
